cache.title: Game cache
cache.hint: Fixes “mods stopped working after the patch” and frees space. Only the client cache goes: hangar web pages, dossiers, clan and collection pictures, crash reports. Replays, game settings, mods and battle results are never touched. The game must be closed; the client downloads the cache again on start.
cache.confirmTitle: Clear {count, plural, one {# cache folder} other {# cache folders}} ({size})?
cache.confirmDescription: The next game start takes a little longer: the client downloads the cache again.
